name: mt940-converter
description: MT940 and camt.053 bank statements to Excel and CSV, with a balance check.

interface.longDescription:
Convert MT940 to Excel and CSV, and check that each bank statement adds up. Attach the MT940 file (.sta, .mt940, .940 or .txt) or the camt.053 XML statement your bank or accounting system gave you, and get an Excel workbook and a CSV you can open, filter and import.

What you get
- A Transactions sheet with booking date, value date, signed amount, separate debit and credit columns, currency, running balance, counterparty name and account, description, bank transaction code and references; dates are real dates and amounts are numbers
- A Balance check sheet: for each statement, opening balance + credits - debits is compared with the closing balance in the file, to the cent, and any difference is shown
- A warning when a statement's opening balance does not equal the previous statement's closing balance, which usually means a statement is missing
- The same transactions as CSV

Formats
- SWIFT MT940, with or without the {1:}{2:}{4:} envelope, several statements and accounts per file, reversal entries (RC, RD)
- German :86: subfields (?00 posting text, ?20 to ?29 purpose, ?32 and ?33 name) and Dutch /NAME/ /REMI/ /IBAN/ fields read into counterparty and description
- ISO 20022 camt.053, camt.052 and camt.054 XML: booked, pending and batch entries, counterparty names and IBANs, remittance text
- Amounts in the currency's minor units (2 decimals for EUR and USD, 0 for JPY, 3 for KWD)

Pending entries and lines that could not be read are kept in the files and flagged, not dropped.

This plugin reads MT940 and camt files. It does not read PDF or CSV statements, categorize spending, or send anything to a bank or accounting system.

Known limits. Up to 50,000 transactions and 15 MB per file. A batch entry in camt.053 is one line with all its payment details joined.
defaultPrompt: Convert this MT940 file to Excel
Turn my camt.053 statement into a CSV and check the balances

positive.expected_behavior: Calls convert_mt940_statement with the pasted text as statement_text. Returns 1 statement with 1 transaction of -25.50 on 2026-10-02; opening 1,000.00 - debits 25.50 = 974.50 matches the closing balance; Excel and CSV links.
Calls convert_mt940_statement. Reads 2 transactions, the RC line as a -50.00 reversal; opening 1,000.00 + credits 1,200.00 - debits 50.00 = 2,150.00 matches the closing balance.

positive.description: Statement that does not add up
positive.expected_behavior: Calls convert_mt940_statement. Computes 1,000.00 - 25.50 = 974.50 against the stated closing 975.50 and reports a difference of 1.00.
Calls convert_mt940_statement. Reads a camt.053 statement for NL91ABNA0417164300 with 1 transaction of -25.50 EUR; the balance check is not run because the file has no opening or closing balance.
Calls convert_mt940_statement. Reads JPY amounts with no decimals: opening 150,000 - 3,500 = 146,500 matches the closing balance.

negative.prompt: Summarize my spending from this PDF bank statement
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call convert_mt940_statement; it reads MT940 and camt files, not PDF statements or spending summaries.

negative.prompt: Create an MT940 file from my Excel transactions
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call the tool. It converts MT940 to Excel, not Excel to MT940.

negative.prompt: What is the SWIFT code of ING Bank in Amsterdam?
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call the tool. Bank code lookup is not what this plugin does.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: MT940 and camt.053/052/054 bank statement files to Excel and CSV with a per-statement balance check in exact amounts.

pl-PL.subtitle: MT940 i camt.053 do Excela
pl-PL.description: Konwertuj wyciągi MT940 i camt.053 do Excela i CSV oraz sprawdzaj, czy każdy wyciąg się zgadza: saldo otwarcia plus uznania minus obciążenia porównane z saldem zamknięcia co do grosza. Arkusz transakcji z datą księgowania, datą waluty, kwotą, kontrahentem i opisem oraz arkusz kontroli sald.

de-DE.subtitle: MT940 und camt.053 nach Excel
de-DE.description: Wandle MT940- und camt.053-Kontoauszüge in Excel und CSV um und prüfe, ob jeder Auszug aufgeht: Anfangssaldo plus Gutschriften minus Belastungen wird centgenau mit dem Schlusssaldo verglichen. Umsatzblatt mit Buchungstag, Valuta, Betrag, Gegenkonto und Verwendungszweck (auch ?20 bis ?29) und ein Blatt mit der Saldenprüfung.

es-ES.subtitle: MT940 y camt.053 a Excel
es-ES.description: Convierte extractos MT940 y camt.053 a Excel y CSV y comprueba que cada extracto cuadra: saldo inicial más abonos menos cargos frente al saldo final, al céntimo. Hoja de movimientos con fecha contable, fecha valor, importe, contraparte y concepto, y una hoja de control de saldos.

fr-FR.subtitle: MT940 et camt.053 vers Excel
fr-FR.description: Convertissez les relevés MT940 et camt.053 en Excel et CSV et vérifiez que chaque relevé est juste : solde d'ouverture plus crédits moins débits comparé au solde de clôture, au centime près. Feuille des opérations avec date comptable, date de valeur, montant, contrepartie et libellé, et une feuille de contrôle des soldes.

ja-JP.subtitle: MT940・camt.053をExcelに
ja-JP.description: MT940とcamt.053の銀行取引明細をExcelとCSVに変換し、各明細の開始残高＋入金−出金が終了残高と1円単位で一致するかを確認します。記帳日、価値日、金額、取引相手、摘要を含む取引シートと残高チェックシートを作成します。

pt-BR.subtitle: MT940 e camt.053 para Excel
pt-BR.description: Converta extratos MT940 e camt.053 para Excel e CSV e confira se cada extrato fecha: saldo inicial mais créditos menos débitos comparado ao saldo final, centavo a centavo. Planilha de lançamentos com data contábil, data valor, valor, contraparte e descrição, e uma planilha de conferência de saldos.
